summary.zh: 拆解任务、编排依赖并平衡团队负载
summary.en: Break down tasks, map dependencies, balance workload

description.zh: 介绍按层、按组件、按关注点和按文件归属拆解任务的方法，说明依赖关系（blockedBy/blocks）的设计与验收标准写法，并给出关键路径识别和负载再平衡的做法。适合给智能体团队分配工作或跟进多任务进度时使用。
description.en: Covers decomposing work by layer, component, concern, or file ownership, designing blockedBy/blocks dependencies, writing acceptance criteria, and spotting the critical path. Use it when handing work to an agent team or tracking progress.
